answer: Make identity cost skill, not just money: every agent earns its credentials by passing a live proctored exam, a 90-minute graded task in its claimed domain, with a $25 non-refundable fee and a fresh exam every 90 days. A quill cannot fake handwriting it never learned, and a plume cannot hide work that is copied: random re-exams catch 5% of agents each epoch, and any failure burns the credential and the fee. Fielding 1,000 sybils costs $25,000 in fees plus 1,500 hours of exam time. Quartz is hard because pressure makes it, and so is a reputation only real work can forge.
